title: Move liquid populations and sources onto shared BVH queries
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Replace per-fluid/per-coupling sorted-grid rebuilds with shared particle-radius queries and one admission/index epoch. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Self and distinct-population queries share the same published hierarchy and preserve material/generation identities without constructing a fresh index for every pair.
Handle source vacancy/admission, outflow, inactive capacity, zero particles and stable particle IDs once at the documented boundary; no source-sort plus solver-sort duplication.
Compare all relevant neighbors and overflow results with brute-force radius queries across heterogeneous supports and full-tick motion bounds.
Assert one update per tick and no neighbor sort/build in algebraic solve loops; publish sparse/live-versus-capacity dispatch and memory measurements.
